name: run-tests
summary: Run a test command in a directory and report what failed, in structure rather than in prose.

dir.description: working directory the command runs in

command.description: argv. Not a shell string — no quoting rules, no injection surface.

env.description: Variables to ADD to the command's environment. The command never inherits this process's environment — it is built from PATH, HOME, TMPDIR, LANG and nothing else — so anything the command needs must be named here.

ok.description: exit code was 0. This is the admission signal and nothing else is.

total.description: assertions seen, 0 if the output was not TAP

at.description: file:line, when the runner reported one

summary.description: one line, for a human skimming a ledger
